summary: SecureTech Innovations filed an 8-K on August 13, 2026, disclosing entry into a Permanent Subsidiary and Earnout Election Agreement with its subsidiary AI UltraProd, Aiultraprod Group, shareholder AIUP Holding, and Zhejiang Jizhu. The parties elected to forgo a previously contemplated spin-off of the operating business as an independent Nasdaq-listed company, instead retaining it as a permanent subsidiary. This triggers issuance of 357 additional Series A Preferred shares to the shareholder per the No Spin-Off Earnout provision. Transaction Agreements automatically terminate. This eliminates a potential spin-off, simplifying corporate structure. What to watch: subsequent filings for Series A issuance details and any impact on shareholder value.
